Can this be used to create "continuous population pyramids",using two
different data sets for the right hand side and the left hand side.
And can the ribbon=pyramind also be displayed horizontally instead of
vertically?

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: violin plot
parts: Also, geom_violin doesn't support different values for the left and right side. To do that, you could use geom_ribbon, and coord_trans to switch between vertical and horizontal orientation. You could probably also use two geom_area's back to back, giving negative values to one of them.
